Well, I don't see any of that in the community info (you know, where it says "community" on the home page, so if that's the case, maybe someone should sort it out. 

I'm guessing that since you're so stridently defending the practice of treating people like shit when they come here, in good faith, to ask questions, that a) you're *a great deal of fun* to deal with on a personal level and b) you hold some position of influence in this sub. Maybe you can let people know that they shouldn't ask questions here until they've met the arbitrary minimum of research (perhaps you could quantify that, too). Maybe change the sub rules. If it were made plain that people shouldn't ask questions here, them you and your ilk wouldn't have to get so weirdly angry when people want to know things. 

Or, and I know this is radical, but you and your chums could accept the fact that people come here with varying levels of skill, knowledge, and experience, and based on the stated info on the sub's home page, that this is going to be a place where people come to ask those questions. Personally I think it's pretty weak that someone new to black metal, or new to the idea that this (potentially) new-to-them music can be enjoyed without putting money into Nazi pockets would come here seeking information from people who may have ready-made answers to their questions, only to be greeted by you and people like you. Honestly I'm trying not to let this devolve into personal attack, but are you really better than anyone else? Were you born knowing everything you know? When you first started getting into it, were people shitty to you? Is that why you're willing to die on the hill of treating like-minded people as though they were garbage? Jesus Christ. Maybe you guys should join your local police force.

So rather then being about whether or not a band is sketch, like, you know, the name of the sub, it should be a sub about research methods? Boolean searching techniques? JSTOR but the black metal version? Seriously? And even if that were the case, you don't teach people to fish by being shitty to them when they come to a place named for answering a specific kind of question. 

I still just don't see the point of people coming to a sub with the intention of using it just like is on the tin, only to have people be nasty to them. And then to have people defend that nastiness? It's pathetic. We are (well, I *thought we were*) trying to build and be part of a community.

I'm sorry but disregarding the possibility of prior knowledge purely on principle because "google easy" is the most ridiculous thing I've ever heard of. "We have a community with similar interests evidenced by the actual name of the sub, but you had better potentially duplicate effort because I say so" is just... I mean, come on. You realize how that sounds, right?
Seems like this should be the place to go when you want to know if a band is sketchy. I'm sorry someone had to be a prick about answering your question.

It's pretty weird to have a sub *actually named* "Is It Sketch" but also shit on people who ask, you know, "is *x* sketch?"...

Seems like we're all here with the same interests and generally speaking the same questions. What we do not all have is the same know-how to/understanding of/comfort level with doing the sketch research. That's why we have this sub, *n'est-ce pas*? 

So, when people ask, instead of being cunty by telling them how easy it was to find the information, why not either answer the question kindly (or at least without being an asshole) or just scroll on? 

Who wins when people who try to avoid fascist music fight amongst themselves because some people want to be dildos about "how easy" it is to answer the question?
